title: Arkret Collision Preimage Record
description: One complete canonical Event preimage stored outside the fork-resolution Event so a full-hash collision on an Event close to the 1 MiB ceiling can still be adjudicated. It is a typed non-Event governance-dependency object: it is never a Seal covered_set member, and the Seal covers the resolution Control Move that references it, not this record. Availability of the record is a transport concern; the authority is the proof plus the independently recomputed Event identity.

schema.description: Payload schema id (versioned). This object has no owning Event kind: it is resolved through the registered governance-dependency surface.

realm_id.description: Realm whose recovery authority produced this record. It MUST equal the Realm of the referencing fork-resolution Event; a record from another Realm MUST be rejected.

collision_event_id.description: The colliding Event identity. The receiver MUST independently recompute this identity from canonical_event_bytes_b64u and reject any mismatch instead of trusting the carried value.

canonical_event_bytes_b64u.description: Canonical unpadded base64url of the complete canonical Event preimage bytes.

canonical_event_size_bytes.description: Decoded length of canonical_event_bytes_b64u in octets. The receiver MUST reject a record whose decoded length differs, so a truncated transfer cannot present itself as a shorter legal preimage.

proof.description: Detached proof in context ak.collision_variant_record_proof.v1. Its controller MUST equal the referencing resolution Move's executed_by ?? actor_id, and that principal MUST be the verified holder of the recovery capability the Move carries.
